# Module `lune_ui_platform::material`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_platform`](index.md)

OS backdrop material behind a transparent window.

The effect is applied by the platform: `NSVisualEffectView` / `NSGlassEffectView` on macOS,
DWM system backdrops on Windows, nothing elsewhere. The platform code lives in `#[cfg]`
submodules; this file holds the shared entry point and the [`Backdrop`](../lune-ui-core/backdrop.md#trait.Backdrop) implementation for a winit
window. The request types are in [`crate::backdrop`](../lune-ui-core/backdrop.md).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-platform/src/material.rs:1`

## Functions

<a id="fn.apply"></a>
### Function `apply`

```rust
pub fn apply(window: &winit::window::Window, material: Material) -> Result<(), String>
```

Applies `material` to `window`, first clearing any material applied earlier.

`Opaque` is `Ok` everywhere. A glass material on a platform without OS glass is an `Err`.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-platform/src/material.rs:43`

<a id="fn.apply_rounded"></a>
### Function `apply_rounded`

```rust
pub fn apply_rounded(
    window: &winit::window::Window,
    material: Material,
    radius: f64,
) -> Result<(), String>
```

[`apply`](material.md#fn.apply), with the OS glass view's corners rounded to `radius` logical pixels, for a window whose
card is rounded. On macOS the glass view follows the radius; elsewhere the radius is ignored: the
window's own corners are the OS's, and this is [`apply`](material.md#fn.apply).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-platform/src/material.rs:50`
